## MSYS Sandbox Compat v0.1.1

This Windows x64 update reduces intermittent MSYS fork failures under native PSEC. The shim expands its temporary process-creation reservation from `[24,64)` to `[8,64)` GiB, keeping early Windows allocations out of the low preferred addresses observed for affected MSYS DLLs. The creator releases the reservation before handing off the child thread. The command line and policy format are unchanged.

On Windows 11 x64 build `26300.9974` with native PSEC 1.0, official MSYS2 3.6.12-1 and Perl 5.44.0-1, eight lanes of `fork.pl 100` improved from **795/800** to **800/800** passing rounds. The old run reported two parent/child DLL base mismatches, one occupied Perl XS DLL address, and two child exits with `0xc0000018`. The exact occupants in those failed Perl children remain undetermined. The test used one host without the third-party injection reported in the external environment. [Test details](https://github.com/hzqmwne/msys-sandbox-compat/blob/v0.1.1/docs/testing.md#psec-fork-stress-and-address-sampling)

The ZIP contains `msys-sandbox-compat-shim.exe`, `psec-run.exe`, documentation, and license notices. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers the ZIP and both standalone executables.

##

这个 Windows x64 更新降低了原生 PSEC 下 MSYS 偶发 fork 失败的概率。shim 将创建进程时的临时预留从 `[24,64)` 扩大到 `[8,64)` GiB，使 Windows 的早期分配避开受影响 DLL 的低位首选地址。创建者在交还子线程前释放预留。命令行和策略格式沿用上一版。

在 Windows 11 x64 `26300.9974`、原生 PSEC 1.0、官方 MSYS2 3.6.12-1 和 Perl 5.44.0-1 下，8 路 `fork.pl 100` 压测从 **795/800** 提升到 **800/800**。旧批次两次报告父子 DLL 基址不同，一次报告 Perl XS DLL 地址已被占用，两次子进程以 `0xc0000018` 退出。这些 Perl 失败现场的具体占用者仍待取证。结果来自单台宿主，未覆盖外部问题环境报告的第三方注入。 [测试详情](https://github.com/hzqmwne/msys-sandbox-compat/blob/v0.1.1/docs/zh-CN/testing.md#psec-fork-压测与地址采样)

ZIP 包含 `msys-sandbox-compat-shim.exe`、`psec-run.exe`、文档和许可声明。`SHA256SUMS.txt` 覆盖 ZIP 和两个独立程序。
